scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of the exact finite-corridor optimizer and asymptotic; finite numerical checks are supplementary. The reviewed finding has no external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: One initially dormant seed, sequential one-way movement and no finite deadline; this is not a population-growth or evolutionarily stable-strategy result.
Perfect habitat recognition in the comparison policy is an information-theoretic benchmark, not a measured capability.
The universal long-corridor law requires a common positive bound on one-step exit from retention and fixed target survival strictly below one.
The 1980 Venable–Lawlor full article was unavailable for full-text priority comparison. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Universal inverse-distance germination penalty in a heterogeneous habitat corridor
